args.title: Correct time zone handling for weekly rollup notifications
args.body:
File: src/notifications/rollup.ts

The sendWeeklyRollups function and its reliance on time zone conversion possibly leads to incorrect scheduling. To fix this, enhance the time zone calculation and interval handling in sendWeeklyRollups, ensuring the summaries are sent at 08:00 as expected in the user's local time zone.

This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The issue is due to incorrect time zone handling in the function responsible for sending weekly rollup notifications. The current logic does not correctly account for local times in all time zones, leading to delayed email delivery for some users.
